slides.headline: Emo Orchestra in Fort Lauderdale, Nov. 10
slides.body: Tuesday at 6 p.m. at Revolution Live in Fort Lauderdale. Tickets are $44. The Spill Canvas plays songs by Taking Back Sunday, Fall Out Boy, A Day to Remember, and The Used.

photo.query: Revolution Live Fort Lauderdale concert venue
photo.prompt: dramatic rock concert inside a Fort Lauderdale venue with an orchestra setup and dark stage lighting

slides.headline: Doja Cat at Kaseya Center, Nov. 11
slides.body: Wednesday at 7:30 p.m. at Kaseya Center in Miami. Tickets are $39 to $159. Latto opens on the Ma Vie World Tour.

photo.query: Doja Cat concert Kaseya Center Miami
photo.prompt: Doja Cat performing on a bright arena stage in Miami with dancers, lights and a full crowd

slides.headline: Nu Deco Ensemble with Common, Nov. 12
slides.body: Thursday at 8 p.m. at the Adrienne Arsht Center in Miami. Tickets are $70 to $298. The show mixes Common’s catalog with orchestral arrangements.

photo.query: Adrienne Arsht Center Miami concert hall
photo.prompt: orchestra performing inside a grand Miami concert hall with a rapper at center stage

slides.credit: Photo: Mary Mark Ockerbloom / CC BY-SA 4.0

slides.headline: NightGarden opens in Coral Gables, Nov. 12
slides.body: Thursday from 6 to 10 p.m. at Fairchild Tropical Botanic Garden in Coral Gables. Tickets are $32 to $35, and ice-skating tickets are $18 to $21. The season opens with light installations, a laser show, and a rink under the palms.

photo.query: NightGarden Fairchild Tropical Botanic Garden lights
photo.prompt: glowing tropical garden paths at night in Coral Gables with palm trees, colorful lights and an ice rink

slides.headline: Miami Short Film Festival opens, Nov. 13
slides.body: Friday at 8 p.m. at O Cinema South Beach in Miami Beach. All-access passes are $100, and opening night is the 25th anniversary program, Echoes We Carry.

photo.prompt: art house movie theater in Miami Beach at night with a glowing marquee and film festival crowd
